林大人，你可还有话要说？（林大人，你可还有话要说？（第22页）这怎么跟预想的不一样？整个天阙城谁不知道忠义侯贪财好色，送到嘴边的肉，怎么反倒吐出来了？他愣愣地看着汪海那张正气凛然的脸，脑子飞速转动，忽然注意到汪海身后探出半个脑袋的萧璃月。那个曾经名动京城的萧家大小姐，此刻怯怯地拽着汪海的衣角，眼神懵懂，像个不谙世事的孩童。萧家被抄，满门一百三十七口只剩她一个。而她如今的模样，分明是被彻底驯服。林正道心头猛地一寒，脊背蹿起一股凉意。一个可怕的想法浮上脑海。莫非汪海本就打算像对付萧家那样，先屠灭林家满门，再把若雪留下，变成下一个萧璃月？“不……”林正道浑身发抖，嘴唇哆嗦着说不出完整的句子。“侯爷。”一个清冷的声音忽然响起。林若雪抬起头，脸上泪痕未干，眼中却已没有了方才的慌乱。她款步上前，越过跪在地上的父亲，站在汪海面前三步之处，盈盈拜下。“小女子愿意替侯爷出手，引出萧凡。”“哦？”汪海挑了挑眉，转身看向她，眼中闪过一丝兴味。“林小姐不亏是七窍玲珑心，果然聪慧。”他缓步走到林若雪面前，伸手捏住她的下巴，迫她抬起头来。那张脸确实生得极美。眉如远山含黛，唇似樱桃点红，一双眸子清澈见底，仿佛能映出人心最深处的秘密。汪海松开手，退后一步，似笑非笑地看着她。“不过，我该如何信你呢？”“万一你给萧凡通风报信，本侯的布置岂不是白费了？”林若雪垂下眼帘，沉默了片刻。“今晚，我会取信于你。”汪海看着她，嘴角缓缓勾起一抹满意的弧度。“那再好不过。”他要的就是这个。林若雪，有着七窍玲珑心。这并非夸张之辞，而是她与生俱来的特殊体质。七窍玲珑心，天生七情通明，聪慧过人。拥有此心者，不仅悟性远超常人，修炼任何功法都能举一反三、一日千里，更可以在心甘情愿的前提下与一人缔结心血契约，从此心意相通，共享悟性。原著中，林若雪正是将这份心意给了萧凡，让他在武道感悟上突飞猛进，屡屡突破瓶颈。这份大礼，如今归他了。汪海伸手，将林若雪从地上扶了起来，指腹擦过她手腕内侧细腻的肌肤，触手冰凉。“林小姐既然这般深明大义，本侯自然乐意成全。”他转头看向还跪在地上的林正道，脸上重新挂起那副和善的笑容。“林大人，令千金愿意将功折罪，本侯便给你林家一个机会。窝藏钦犯之事，暂不追究。”林正道浑身一软，差点瘫倒在地，连声叩首：“多谢侯爷！多谢侯爷！”汪海没有再看林正道一眼，揽着林若雪纤细的腰肢，大步往府门外走去。萧璃月乖巧地跟在身后，像条小尾巴似的寸步不离。青鸢带着凤卫在府门外等候，见他出来，眉头微微一皱，目光在他怀中那身素白罗裙上停留了一瞬，没有多言。“回府。”汪海翻身上马，将林若雪拉上马背坐在身前，一抖缰绳，乌云踏雪四蹄翻飞，直奔忠义侯府而去。怀中女子的身子微微颤抖，却没有挣扎。夜风中，他低头看了她一眼，那双含着泪光的眼睛望向漆黑的街道，像是和过去彻底告别，也像是在祭奠那颗刚刚死去的心。……

Mr. Lin, do you have anything else to say? (Mr. Lin, do you have anything else to say? (Page 22) How is this different from what was expected? Who in the whole Tianque City doesn’t know that Marquis Zhongyi is greedy for money and lust, so how come he spits out the meat that comes to his mouth? He stared blankly at Wang Hai’s upright face, his mind was spinning rapidly, and he suddenly noticed Xiao Liyue with half her head sticking out from behind Wang Hai. The eldest daughter of the Xiao family, who was once famous in the capital, was timidly dragging Wang along. Hai's clothes were confused, like a child who didn't understand the world. The Xiao family was confiscated, and she was the only one left in the family of 137. Lin Zhengdao felt a chill in her heart. , a chill ran down my spine. A terrible thought came to mind. Could it be that Wang Hai planned to kill the entire Lin family first, and then leave Ruoxue behind to become the next Xiao Liyue? "Lin Zhengdao was trembling all over, and his lips were trembling, unable to speak a complete sentence. "Master Hou." A cold voice suddenly sounded. Lin Ruoxue raised her head, with tears still on her face, but the panic was no longer in her eyes. She stepped forward, stood three steps in front of Wang Hai, and bowed down. "The little girl is willing to take action for Master Hou, and lead Xiao Fan out." "Oh?" Wang Hai raised his eyebrows and turned around. Looking at her, there was a hint of interest in his eyes. "Miss Lin is indeed a smart person." He walked slowly to Lin Ruoxue, stretched out his hand to hold her chin, and forced her to raise her head. Her eyebrows were like a distant mountain, her lips were as red as a cherry, and her eyes were so clear that they seemed to reflect the deepest secrets of the human heart. "However, I looked at her with a half-smile. How should I trust you?" "If you inform Xiao Fan, wouldn't my arrangement be in vain?" Lin Ruoxue lowered her eyes and was silent for a moment. "I will trust you tonight." Wang Hai looked at her with a smile of satisfaction. "That's the best." Lin Ruoxue has a delicate heart. This is not an exaggeration, but her innate special constitution. A person with an exquisite heart is born with clear understanding of all seven emotions and is extremely intelligent. Not only does his understanding far exceed that of ordinary people, but he can also draw inferences about other cases and make great progress in any practice. He can also form a relationship with someone willingly. After forming a blood contract, their minds are connected and they share understanding. In the original work, Lin Ruoxue gave this heart to Xiao Fan, allowing him to make rapid progress in his martial arts understanding and repeatedly break through bottlenecks. This great gift now belongs to him. Wang Hai stretched out his hand and lifted Lin Ruoxue up from the ground. His fingertips brushed against the delicate skin on the inside of her wrist. "Since Miss Lin understands the righteousness so well, I am naturally willing to fulfill it." He turned to look at Lin Zhengdao, who was still kneeling on the ground, with the kind smile on his face again. "Master Lin, I will give you the Lin family a chance if you are willing to give up the crime. I will not pursue the matter of harboring the criminal." Lin Zhengdao felt weak and almost collapsed to the ground, and he kowtowed repeatedly: "Thank you, Lord Marquis! Thank you, Lord Marquis!" Wang Hai didn't look at Lin Zhengdao again, put his arm around Lin Ruoxue's slender waist, and strode out of the house. Liyue followed obediently, staying close to him like a little tail. Qingyuan and Fengwei waited outside the mansion. When she saw him coming out, she frowned slightly and her eyes lingered on the plain white skirt in his arms for a moment.Not much to say. "Go back to the house." Wang Hai got on the horse, pulled Lin Ruoxue on the horse and sat in front of him. With a shake of the reins, the black clouds flew over the snow and went straight to the Zhongyi Hou Mansion. The body of the woman in her arms trembled slightly, but she did not struggle. In the night wind, he looked down at her, his tearful eyes looking towards the dark street, as if he was saying goodbye to the past completely, and as if he was paying homage to the heart that had just died. …
